interpretation: The standalone TEST_ONLY binary exercised actual Winsock UDP send/echo mechanics against owned loopback responders. The negative echo case retained local send acceptance while rejecting a nonmatching response. This establishes a usable mechanism and its distinction between API acceptance and validated echo, not any contained application network boundary.
next: Integration and any full guest run require separate reviewed scope; no identical mechanism replay is needed.
privacy: Closed counts/phase indices/status/cleanup and public CI/source metadata only. No private nonce, socket tuple, process identity, raw packet, credential or exception text.
